args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — in all regions. The rollback was verified: all three regions are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

The service is now healthy in all production regions on v2.3.0.
